summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of requirements (label assignment, priority conflicts, multiple formats, error handling). Tests are organized into three layers (functionality, workflow structure, act harness) with clear naming and good use of fixtures. Minor gaps in rigor: missing tests for invalid --format values, --help flag, and explicit format-default validation. The run_act_harness.sh output parsing is somewhat brittle, depending on specific markers (case-basic, case-conflict, endgroup) not documented in provided workflow code. Would catch most regressions but would benefit from tighter validation of edge cases and more documentation of workflow output format expectations.
